find: He instructs the group to find a man — any man — and plant Adam’s DNA on him, so the police will arrest an innocent person for Adam’s supposed murder. “We’ve found a man,” the group later reports. Phil’s plan requires the group to steal Adam’s jumper (which has his DNA on it) and leave it near this stranger.

The police will find the jumper and arrest him for Adam’s supposed murder.
note: F1: the planted DNA is the innocent man’s, not Adam’s.

find: The plan works. A man who lives near the field is arrested.
replace: The plan works. Cathy finds a postman who matches the description and gets him to handle the jumper. He is arrested, and Brian then picks him out for the police.
